title: 第1923章 一拳打碎第1922章 离开虎夔城
slug: 噬神塔第1929章小金的战力
lines: 虎夔城是秦易进入二级宇宙文明的第一站。
虽然停留时间不算太长，但是也让他正式迈入了造化境行列，而且还在这么短的时间内，达到了造化境三重。
以他史无前例的十节命轮突破到造化境，仅仅只是三重，就能斩杀七重极限，战力碾压造化境八重。
这种可怕潜力，恐怕放眼整个二级宇宙文明，也不常见。
与血源大人一战，真正让秦易彻底将造化境三重的感悟，全部融会贯通。
如今的他，相比于之前，已经发生了翻天覆地的变化。
一路上，胡鸣都在跟凌敏交流。
“你这家伙，真是走了狗屎运了。”
凌敏撇嘴说道：“将巴林家族的公主，完好无损的救回去，这可是大功一件啊，会直接影响到你的积分。”
所谓积分，就是巴林家族的年轻一辈，不管是嫡系血脉，还是庶出血脉，凡是有资格竞争下一任族长的人选，每个人都有积分。
初始积分为零，只要做出对家族有贡献的事情，都会获得不同程度的积分。
“你现在积分多少？”秦易好奇问道。
胡鸣低头自顾自的前行，略显尴尬，似乎不太想回答这个问题。
一旁的凌敏笑着说道：“这家伙现在积分是零。”
额！
秦易愣了一下，而后摇了摇头。
凌敏问道：“秦先生，你之后有什么打算？”
打算吗？
前往西玄宇宙文明麾下的太虚剑宗算不算？
当然，这种事情，他不想让别人知道。
他看了一眼凌敏，说道：“暂时还没什么打算，先努力提升修为吧。”
凌敏道：“以秦先生你的实力，在巴林家族中，都不一定有对手，有你帮助胡鸣，他一定能成功脱颖而出的。”
然而。
就在两人说话之际，突然前方的山脉中，冲出了一伙人。
轰！
他们身上散发着恐怖的气息，直接将胡鸣拦住。
“站住。”
为首之人是一个独眼龙，他背部背着一个弓箭，认真观察胡鸣，而后还拿出了一张画像，确认眼前之人，就是画像中的人之后，他冷笑一声，说道：“你就是我们要找的人。”
胡鸣皱眉，他还没回到巴林家族呢，就有人想要截杀他？
到底是谁？
难道是邱长老吗？
“你们是谁？”
胡鸣冷声问道。
content_en:
Hukui City is Qin Yi's first stop to enter the second-level cosmic civilization.
Although the stay was not too long, it also allowed him to officially enter the ranks of the Creation Realm, and he also reached the third level of the Creation Realm in such a short period of time.
With his unprecedented ten-section life wheel, he broke through to the realm of creation. With just the third level, he was able to kill the limit of the seventh level, and his combat power crushed the eighth level of the creation realm.
This kind of terrifying potential is probably not common in the entire secondary universe civilization.
The battle with Master Bloodyuan truly allowed Qin Yi to fully comprehend all the insights of the third level of Creation Realm.
Today, he has undergone earth-shaking changes compared to before.
Along the way, Hu Ming was communicating with Ling Min.
"You guys are really lucky."
Ling Min pouted and said, "Rescuing the princess of the Bahrain family intact is a great achievement and will directly affect your points."
The so-called points refer to the younger generation of the Bahrain family, whether they are direct bloodline or common bloodline. Anyone who is qualified to compete for the next clan leader will have points.
The initial points are zero. As long as you do something that contributes to the family, you will get points to varying degrees.
"How many points do you have now?" Qin Yi asked curiously.
Hu Ming lowered his head and walked forward by himself, looking slightly embarrassed and not seeming to want to answer the question.
Ling Min on the side smiled and said: "This guy has zero points now."
Uh!
Qin Yi was stunned for a moment, then shook his head.
Ling Min asked: "Mr. Qin, what are your plans in the future?"
Planning to?
Does going to the Taixu Sword Sect under the Xixuan Universe Civilization count?
Of course, he didn't want others to know about this kind of thing.
He glanced at Ling Min and said, "I don't have any plans for the time being. Let's work hard to improve our cultivation first."
Ling Min said: "With your strength, Mr. Qin, you may not have any rivals in the Bahrain family. With your help, Hu Ming will definitely be able to stand out."
However.
Just as the two were talking, a group of people suddenly rushed out of the mountains ahead.
boom!
They exuded a terrifying aura and stopped Hu Ming directly.
"Stop."
The leader was a one-eyed dragon. He carried a bow and arrow on his back. He carefully observed Hu Ming, and then took out a portrait. After confirming that the person in front of him was the person in the portrait, he sneered and said, "You are the person we are looking for."
Hu Ming frowned. Before he returned to the Bahrain family, someone wanted to intercept and kill him?
Who is it?
Could it be Elder Qiu?
"Who are you?"
Hu Ming asked coldly.
